title: Comcast turns your Xfinity WiFi into a home motion detector
summary: However, while Comcast is now making WiFi Motion a major part of its WiFi Shield security offering, the motion detection feature isn't new. A Reddit post from August 21, 2024, shows an Xfinity customer receiving an email introducing WiFi Motion.
